falsification.description: a devirtualized call is claimed slot-preserving with no static-call-lowering record to join
falsification.why: a devirtualization record without a static-call-lowering partner would mean the transform happened and the edge it produced never reached the cell
falsification.observed: target cls:OnlyShape::method:describe, caller fn:main: 6 devirtualization + 3 static-call-lowering records, both SLOT_PRESERVING, with 1 instance-dispatch UNMODELED_BLOCKING and installation refused

falsification.description: an instance member is installable although no instance-call path traverses the cell
falsification.why: an instance member installable while no instance-call path traverses the cell is the divergence this issue exists to prevent -- it was real until this rule existed
falsification.observed: install refused (-3), the call still returns OLD-DEVIRT cold and OLD-DEVIRT hot, and the descriptor never claims otherwise

falsification.description: a vm:prefer-inline mutable callee is inlined, so its caller cannot observe a replacement
falsification.why: a vm:prefer-inline mutable callee that got inlined could not observe a replacement; the rule must beat an explicit inline request
falsification.observed: prefer-inline callee: OLD-TINY -> NEW-TINY, still NEW-TINY after 200000 iterations

falsification.description: a declaration the release never calls is dropped and becomes unpatchable
falsification.why: a declaration the release never calls must stay addressable, or dead code becomes unpatchable
falsification.observed: never called by the release: AOT:v1 -> PATCH_CODE:v2, install 0

falsification.description: a bypassed dispatch cell goes undetected because escape detection is disabled
falsification.why: without detection a bypass installs and the program keeps the release answer
falsification.observed: no_detect: install 0, call OLD-TINY, escapes 0 -- versus bypass install -3

falsification.description: escape metadata is produced but no install decision reads it
falsification.why: metadata produced but unread must fail exactly like no metadata at all
falsification.observed: no_consume: install 0, call OLD-TINY, escapes 6 -- versus bypass install -3

falsification.description: escape state is dropped when the registry is rebuilt at materialization
falsification.why: state lost in the rebuild silently re-opens every disqualified declaration
falsification.observed: drop_state: install 0, call OLD-TINY, escapes 0 -- versus bypass install -3

falsification.why: a blocking disposition that does not block, and a consumed_by string that claims a consumer the projection no longer reaches
falsification.observed: bypass: 18 blocking decisions, projection 6, refused. drop-state: 18 blocking decisions still serialized, projection 0, installed anyway

falsification.description: DEPENDENCY_REQUIRED admits an optimization with no dependency token and no consumer
falsification.why: DEPENDENCY_REQUIRED with no dependency token and no consumer would admit an optimization on a promise

falsification.description: the disposition model blocks everything, so blocking carries no information
falsification.why: a model that blocks every disposition carries no information; SLOT_PRESERVING must NOT block
falsification.observed: SLOT_PRESERVING installs and runs the replacement; FORBIDDEN=-3, UNMODELED_BLOCKING=-3, DEPENDENCY_REQUIRED=-3

falsification.description: a constant result is folded through a mutable boundary, so the call reaches the cell and the caller ignores it
falsification.why: the call still reaches the cell and the caller uses the folded release answer -- path evidence perfect, program wrong. This shipped once.
falsification.observed: folding re-enabled: 6 call sites still emitted, 9 escapes recorded, install -3, call OLD-TINY

falsification.why: if optimization changed mutation semantics, the conservative posture would be the only thing making them work

falsification.why: promoting a whole #64 row from one dispatch mode is an overclaim, and #68 adds no cell to what #67 linked
falsification.observed: 3 rows linked, all still UNMODELED; RS-09 claims no modes at all

RS-09.row_title: inline caches and dispatch specialization state
not_covered: every mode -- the row is scaffolded with none

inlining.rule: a selected declaration is never inlined, because an inlined copy is a caller that cannot reach the dispatch cell
inlining.enforcement: precompiler.cc SeedMutableAotRoots sets is_inlinable(false); inliner.cc ShouldWeInline refuses before AlwaysInline, so a force-inline pragma cannot win
inlining.producer: the refusal is structural -- no inlined copy exists to record
inlining.consumer: none needed: the optimization does not happen. The OBSERVABLE consequence is that a vm:prefer-inline mutable callee still observes its replacement

constant-folding.rule: no constant result may be attached to a call whose target is mutable; the caller would use the release answer while the call still reaches the cell
constant-folding.enforcement: transformer.dart suppresses the constant; kernel_binary_flowgraph.cc BuildStaticInvocation records FORBIDDEN if one arrives anyway

static-call-lowering.rule: a direct or static call to a mutable target must load the dispatch cell
static-call-lowering.consumer: nothing reads a slot-preserving record; it is positive evidence. The ABSENCE of the lowering is what is consumed -- it records FORBIDDEN and refuses install

devirtualization.rule: the optimizer may turn an instance call into a static call; the resulting edge must still traverse the cell
devirtualization.enforcement: kernel_binary_flowgraph.cc, every DirectCallMetadata-to-StaticCall site including BuildMethodInvocation and the dynamic forwarders
devirtualization.producer: NoteDecision naming the function TFA proved, not the forwarder that gets called
devirtualization.consumer: nothing reads it directly; the gate joins it with the static-call-lowering record for the same target and caller, and a devirtualization without that partner would leave the target with zero emitted call sites

instance-dispatch.rule: a selected INSTANCE member is reachable by dispatch forms #68 does not model

target-architecture.rule: a target with no Mutable-AOT call lowering cannot host a replaceable declaration
target-architecture.falsification: covered structurally: the arm64 build records no such escape, and the guard is the #else branch of the only lowering that exists. H13 covers the related "binaries not built from these sources" case

tfa-retention.rule: a selected declaration the release never calls must survive tree shaking and stay addressable
tfa-retention.enforcement: pragma.dart makes maot:mutable an entry point; precompiler.cc AddFunction with kMutableAotDeclaration
tfa-retention.producer: the registry entry itself, with indirect_call_sites_emitted = 0
tfa-retention.consumer: nothing blocks; the observable consequence is that the declaration is installable and its version advances

dependency-carrying optimizations.rule: an optimization that crosses the boundary is allowed only with invalidation state the install path can act on
dependency-carrying optimizations.producer: nothing produces one yet -- Phase B owns the token
dependency-carrying optimizations.consumer: none exists, which is precisely why it fails closed. Admitting it today would be admitting an optimization on a promise

unmodeled optimizer classes.rule: CHA, polymorphic-call specialization, dispatch-table specialization, tear-off target caching, recognized/intrinsic replacement and accessor subsumption are not modeled by #68
unmodeled optimizer classes.enforcement: they can only reach a mutable declaration through an instance member or a tear-off; instance members are blocked above, and a tear-off of a mutable member is an instance member too
unmodeled optimizer classes.falsification: H08 -- the same arm, because the same blocker covers them. Stated rather than claimed as separately proven

condition_meanings.every_optimizer_class_has_a_rule: does every optimizer class #68 names have a rule with an enforcement site, a disposition, a producer, a consumer and a falsification?
condition_meanings.blocking_dispositions_actually_block: measured, not read from the enum: does each blocking disposition produce an install refusal, and does SLOT_PRESERVING not?
condition_meanings.conservative_posture_holds: do all the adversarial variants -- prefer-inline callee, constant-return callee, nested chain, mutable caller with immutable callee and the inverse -- observe their replacements?
condition_meanings.hot_sites_observe_replacement: do heavily-executed precompiled call sites observe it too, after enough iterations to specialize?
condition_meanings.second_replacement_advances: does a second install move the version again and execute the second body?
condition_meanings.devirtualization_join_present: for the devirtualized target, does the record carry BOTH a devirtualization and a static-call-lowering decision, same target and caller, both SLOT_PRESERVING?
condition_meanings.unmodeled_dispatch_blocks_install: is a selected instance member recorded UNMODELED_BLOCKING and its installation refused, until #69?
condition_meanings.dead_release_declaration_addressable: is a declaration the release never calls still installable, with its version advancing?
condition_meanings.escape_metadata_is_consumed: does removing the detection, the consumption, or the state at materialization each let a bypass install successfully? Metadata nobody reads must fail exactly like no metadata.
condition_meanings.blocking_record_survives_to_the_consumer: when a blocking decision exists, does its escape projection survive into the descriptor AND does the real install decision refuse? A consumed_by string alone must never satisfy this.
condition_meanings.optimized_and_conservative_agree: do the optimized build and a conservative AOT control produce identical mutation semantics?
condition_meanings.required_falsifications_detected: did every required falsification actually fire?
condition_meanings.measurements_recorded: are the size, compile-time, call-cost and prevented-optimization counts present? No threshold is compared.
condition_meanings.build_provenance_bound: were the binaries built from the exact MAOT source bytes the record names?
condition_meanings.target_architecture_recorded: does the record say which architecture this was proven on?
condition_meanings.t0_linkage_exact_and_unpromoted: is the #64 linkage exactly the demonstrated modes, with EB-01, EB-02 and RS-09 all left UNMODELED?

verdict.verdict_rule: arm64_aot_optimizer_invariants == ESTABLISHED iff every condition holds and no non-acceptance blocking finding was raised. issue_68_closure == READY iff that and no acceptance item is unmet. Conjunctions throughout; no count, ratio or threshold is compared, and no outcome string is reachable unconditionally.
not_claimed: M1 is not complete. Virtual, interface, super and the remaining call forms are #69 and #70.
No #64 row is promoted; EB-01, EB-02 and RS-09 stay UNMODELED.
Phase B is not done: no optimization crosses the boundary with invalidation state, because none carries one. DEPENDENCY_REQUIRED fails closed for that reason.
No structural class migration, no additions, no product CLI.
